One-click match report

Source: R/report.R
match_report.Rd

Downloads a game (or takes its play-by-play), runs every game-level analysis in ggbasket and writes a single self-contained HTML report: key findings in words, the game flow, win probability with the plays that swung it, what decided the result, who mattered, every shot, box scores, clutch time and line-ups. The file has its figures inside, so it can be e-mailed or shared as it is.

Usage

match_report(
  game = NULL,
  league = c("EuroLeague", "NBA"),
  season = NULL,
  pbp = NULL,
  file = NULL,
  context = FALSE,
  names = NULL,
  colours = NULL,
  open = interactive()
)

Arguments

game

EuroLeague game code (e.g. 90) or ESPN game id (e.g. "401766128").

league

"EuroLeague" or "NBA".

season

EuroLeague season start year (e.g. 2026 for 2026/27).

pbp

Play-by-play of the game, if already downloaded.

file

Output file (default: "<home>-<away>-<date>.html" in the working directory).

context

Also compare the game with both teams' season so far.

names

Named vector of display names for team codes, e.g. c(OLY = "Olympiacos", MIL = "Olimpia Milano") (default: the full names that come with the play-by-play).

colours

Two team colours, home first.

open

Open the report when done.

Value

The path of the report, invisibly.

Details

A EuroLeague game takes a few seconds to download. With context = TRUE the teams' other games of the season are downloaded too (about a minute) to compare this game with their season.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
match_report(90, "EuroLeague", season = 2026, names = c(OLY = "Olympiacos", MIL = "Milano"))
match_report("401766128", "NBA")
match_report(pbp = subset(pbp_games, game_id == "401766128"), context = FALSE)
} # }
